run_pybullet_simulation: run a pybullet GUI simulation that loads a husky robot and steps physics forward
load_urdf_model: load a URDF robot model like husky.urdf into the pybullet simulation at a given position
control_joint_motors: control robot joint motors using VELOCITY_CONTROL with a target velocity and max force
step_physics_simulation: step the pybullet physics simulation forward a specified number of steps
query_contact_points: query and retrieve contact points for a robot body in the pybullet simulation
